title: Session event-stream subscriber evidence
description: subscribers.json, written beside session.json after the session's event-stream subscribers finish. It never changes session.json or events.jsonl.

sessionId.description: The recorded session the evidence belongs to.

stream.description: The final extent of the session's events.jsonl.

subscribers.description: One entry per declared subscriber, sorted by name, names unique.

position.description: A position in events.jsonl derived from the log itself; no record carries a sequence member.

records.description: LF-terminated records that end at or before offset. Never greater than offset.

evidence.description: One subscriber's delivery evidence. Validators also require lost to equal stream.records minus acknowledged.records, delivered to acknowledge the whole stream, partial to acknowledge some bytes and lost to acknowledge none.

name.description: The subscriber's declared name, for example session-reporter.

evidence.description: delivered: the terminal final marker was acknowledged. partial: some bytes were acknowledged, never the final marker. lost: nothing was acknowledged.

acknowledged.description: The last stream position the subscriber acknowledged.

lost.description: Records after acknowledged that the subscriber never acknowledged within its budget.
